svg.aria-label: A one-page study of imagery and iconography: the depiction ladder, token systems, matrix conventions, line grammar, colour as identity, and three gaps in our own symbol set.
svg.title: Imagery and iconography, on one page
svg.desc: Drawn rather than described, because a text document about pictures is the wrong artifact. Follows the seven part anatomy it documents.

g.inkscape:label: 10 Title
g.text: What the pictures are made of. Read from 27 one-page designs and 8 game manuals.

g.inkscape:label: 20 Depiction ladder
g.text: The level of abstraction is chosen by what the reader has to DO with the picture, never by what was easiest to draw.

g.inkscape:label: rung 2 rendered
g.text: painted art sits here, for tone only
RULE: never mix two rungs inside one drawing. Where a page needs both, zone them. Mixing makes the reader ask which parts are literal.

g.inkscape:label: actor pair
g.text: source and target, stripped to marks.
Any more detail and readers take the

g.inkscape:label: node with vector
g.text: Identity by colour, position by placement,
tendency by the vector. We have nothing

g.inkscape:label: depth bullets
g.text: Hierarchy by hue, not by type size.

g.inkscape:label: callout index
g.text: A callout number ENDS a leader line.
A step number BEGINS a paragraph.

g.inkscape:label: matrix callouts
g.text: readable before the words are learned
an explicit no proves somebody thought
about it. A blank cell proves nothing.
self against self is a special case
symmetry is a real property, so show it

g.inkscape:label: 50 Line grammar
g.text: thin, no head = a LABEL points at a thing
thick, arrowed = FLOW, cause or movement
weight tracks importance: the primary path
is visibly heavier than a branch
A reader must be able to tell a label from a flow without reading either.

g.inkscape:label: 60 Colour identity
g.text: One hue per thing, carried across every depiction of it on the page:
A reader who learns one colour can find everything about it without reading a word.
WHERE IT FAILS: our green and red measure 1.01:1 against each other.
A hue-only notation in our palette dies the moment it is printed. Texture the beads.

g.inkscape:label: 70 Our gaps
g.text: Nothing encodes an ordered series inline. Our steps are numbered
panels, which is heavyweight. The touch fingerprint needs this.
Every symbol we have carries a value. None carries a tendency.
We drew gap matrices without deciding what an empty cell means.
Per-part verdict marks. Nothing in either corpus can say half a page is built.

g.inkscape:label: 99 Footer
g.text: Drawn rather than written, because a text document about pictures is the wrong artifact. Follows the seven part anatomy it documents: title and date, one dominant illustration,
callouts on leader lines, a detail inset, sidebars, a description, and whitespace on purpose.
